## HyperPod Cluster Readiness Assessment: `skilltest-hp-slurm` (us-west-2)

- No pending or recommended software updates — all groups report `ImageVersionStatus: UpToDate`.

- Direct lookup on resource `skilltest-hp-slurm` (Sep 24–Oct 1): **zero events** — no CreateCluster/UpdateCluster/scaling actions.
- Broader check of all mutating SageMaker API calls in the account over the last few days: **all events are read-only** (ListClusters, DescribeCluster, ListClusterNodes, etc. — mostly from monitoring/agent sessions). No write/mutation calls on this cluster at all.
